_doc: OpenBuilds' Eccentric Spacer 6mm (part 226): turned in its plate's hole, it moves a wheel toward or away from its track to set the preload. Read off OpenBuilds' drawing.
name: eccentric-6-openbuilds

eccentric_offset.rule: Its bore stands 0.79 mm off its rim's axis, so a half turn moves the wheel 1.58 mm
eccentric_offset.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Eccentric Spacer 6mm (part 226)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

eccentric_height.rule: Its cam height, between the plate and the wheel: 6 mm (a V-groove or a flat marks the 6 mm one from the 1/4 inch one)
eccentric_height.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Eccentric Spacer 6mm (part 226)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

eccentric_rim_diameter.rule: The round rim under it that turns in the plate's hole: 7.11 across
eccentric_rim_diameter.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Eccentric Spacer 6mm (part 226)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

eccentric_rim_height.rule: How far its rim reaches below the cam into the plate: 2.50
eccentric_rim_height.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Eccentric Spacer 6mm (part 226)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

eccentric_hole.rule: The hole OpenBuilds' plates give the rim: 7.20
eccentric_hole.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "V-Slot Gantry Plate 20mm (part 935)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

eccentric_bore.rule: Its bore, for the wheel's M5 screw: 5
eccentric_bore.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "Eccentric Spacer 6mm (part 226)", as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings
